metricDefinitions.label: Trading days
metricDefinitions.definition: Number of daily observations per security in the reviewed snapshot.

source.label: Reviewed stock performance and risk metrics

metricDefinitions.label: Total return
metricDefinitions.definition: Close-to-close price return across the reviewed period; dividends are not included.

metricDefinitions.label: Annualized volatility
metricDefinitions.definition: Daily return standard deviation annualized with 252 trading days.

metricDefinitions.label: Historical VaR 95%
metricDefinitions.definition: Fifth percentile of observed daily returns. It is a loss threshold, not a maximum possible loss.

assumptions: Price-return analysis excludes dividends and transaction costs.

source.label: Equal-weight sector and benchmark price-return history

metricDefinitions.label: Cumulative return
metricDefinitions.definition: Percentage change from the first close. Sector series are equal-weight averages of constituent cumulative price returns.

assumptions: Sector series are descriptive equal-weight indices, not investable portfolios.

metricDefinitions.label: Monthly return
metricDefinitions.definition: Close-to-close price return for each calendar month.

metricDefinitions.label: Peak volatility
metricDefinitions.definition: Maximum annualized 30-day rolling volatility within the detected episode.

metricDefinitions.label: Correlation
metricDefinitions.definition: Pearson correlation of same-day daily returns during the reviewed period.

metricDefinitions.label: Beta
metricDefinitions.definition: Covariance of stock and S&P 500 daily returns divided by S&P 500 return variance.

metricDefinitions.label: Alpha
metricDefinitions.definition: Annual return residual under the project beta model and 5% risk-free rate.

source.label: Exploratory lead-lag leadership scores

metricDefinitions.label: Lead ratio
metricDefinitions.definition: Average absolute lead correlation divided by average absolute follow correlation; unstable when both are near zero.

assumptions: Lagged correlations are exploratory associations and do not establish causality or tradable predictability.

source.label: Reviewed lagged cross-correlations

metricDefinitions.label: Lagged correlation
metricDefinitions.definition: Correlation between leader return and follower return one to five trading days later.

assumptions: Multiple comparisons and weak observed magnitudes limit inference.

metricDefinitions.label: Maximum drawdown
metricDefinitions.definition: Largest peak-to-trough decline in the close-price wealth index.

source.label: Reviewed optimized and reference portfolio weights

metricDefinitions.label: Portfolio weight
metricDefinitions.definition: Long-only historical sample weight; optimized portfolios cap each position at 15%.

assumptions: Max Sharpe and Min Variance weights are fitted to the full historical sample and are not out-of-sample forecasts.

source.label: Reviewed historical portfolio backtest summary

metricDefinitions.label: Sharpe ratio
metricDefinitions.definition: Annualized excess return divided by annualized volatility using a 5% risk-free rate.

metricDefinitions.label: Maximum drawdown
metricDefinitions.definition: Largest peak-to-trough decline in the historical portfolio wealth index.

assumptions: Static weights, no rebalancing, transaction costs, taxes, or slippage.
Optimized results are in-sample and likely overstate out-of-sample performance.

source.label: Reconstructed static-weight historical portfolio paths

metricDefinitions.label: Portfolio cumulative return
metricDefinitions.definition: Cumulative daily return using fixed normalized starting weights and no rebalancing.

assumptions: Static weights; no fees, taxes, slippage, or interim rebalancing.

metricDefinitions.label: Source rows
metricDefinitions.definition: Security-date observations represented by the 41 reviewed files.
